name: @local/dsh-ac-boot
description: A tactical-briefing opening sequence for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI, drawn as an in-world mission briefing: a holographic command table, a full-bleed theater map, operator clearance and a mission-start title. v0.14.0 removes the literal aircraft key art and rebuilds the sequence around the tactical HUD/map language; Agnes now supplies only two abstract plates (terrain relief and the holographic table). The Host contract is unchanged from 0.13.0: name + inject=['webServer'], splash rows only, and a read-only /acb/assets route. The launch-scoped one-shot behaviour is preserved.
